correctness.rationale: For every q=p^r with p>=7, a bijective normalized-pair substitution gives (z²-w²)F(z,w)=0 for each nonzero sum; exactly 2q−1 trivial pairs with B_q overlap are counted. For sum zero the sixth-power map has kernel size g. Away from 11, the conic weighted by (1+χ(U))(1+χ(V)) reduces to the explicit cubic and quartic character sums, with verified nonvanishing discriminants and correct one/two rational points at infinity. The identities S3=−a_q and S4=−1−b_q give the displayed closed energy formula; the Hasse inequality follows immediately. In characteristic 11 the two nonsingular conic components and four intersections are counted explicitly and all roots in B_q verified. Separate direct finite enumeration by verify_sextic.py succeeds for 15 fields including F_121, F_169; samples supplement rather than replace the unrestricted proof. Orthogonality gives normalized fourth moment A/q².

value.rationale: An infinite-field exact natural Fourier-extension invariant, motivated by precise additive representation structure of a plane monomial curve, is expressed using two explicit elliptic Frobenius traces. A genuinely exceptional prime 11 changes the geometric decomposition and leading energy constant from 3 to 4; the phenomenon cannot be read off general L2-to-L4 boundedness or a finite table. Neither a sharp arbitrary-input norm nor a general downstream theorem is claimed or required for the intrinsic fourth-moment classification.
